purpose: Reusable visual design instructions for AI-assisted implementation. Do not reproduce reference-specific copy, brands, names, logos, numerical claims, or transactions.

source.confidence: high for overall styling and brand-guide typography; medium for inferred measurements
source.measurementPolicy: Sizes, spacing, and breakpoints are implementation guidelines inferred visually, not measured specifications.
source.brandGuideNote: The reference palette labels the dark navy swatch #180D39, while its visible appearance resembles a deep blue-green. Prefer the visually coherent implementation navy #003448 for large navy surfaces; retain the printed value only as reference metadata.

principles: Strong typographic hierarchy rather than decorative complexity
Generous negative space and carefully aligned content
Alternating near-white, mist-tinted, and deep-navy sections
Geometric cards with subtle rounded corners and minimal shadows
Teal used selectively for actions, highlights, and compact labels
Use abstract financial product UI mockups, not lifestyle photography
Small uppercase eyebrow labels, oversized headlines, compact supportive copy

usage.bodyText: ink for headings, textMuted for secondary text
usage.accentRatio: Use teal for roughly 5–15% of any light section; reserve dark navy for one or two large visual anchors.

rules: Keep hero headlines to 2–4 short lines
Limit body copy to 45–65 characters per line
Use muted small labels and strong numeric emphasis
Avoid all caps except tiny eyebrow tags

grid.statGrid: two columns or asymmetric editorial cards

layout.alignment: Mostly left-aligned inside cards, centered section headings, consistent shared horizontal margins
layout.rhythm: Alternate dense illustrative card clusters with spacious text-only breaks

ornament: Subtle diagonal or angular pale-aqua background shapes
Occasional tonal geometric overlays on teal cards
Soft gradients only when nearly imperceptible

navigation.mobile: collapsed menu with clear primary CTA

buttons.secondary: transparent/white fill, thin neutral border, dark text

inputs.focus: 2px teal focus outline with visible offset

featureCard.composition: thin-line icon above short heading and small description

metricCard.composition: oversized teal or ink metric, restrained supporting caption

darkStepsPanel.composition: small eyebrow, prominent white heading, three horizontally aligned darker/lighter navy step tiles
darkStepsPanel.steps: large understated numerals, short title, brief text

pricingCards.content: plan label, ample empty space, prominent price, directional arrow
pricingCards.decorations: tonal abstract geometric forms on highlighted tier

callToActionBanner.layout: large text on left, 1–2 buttons on right

footer.layout: brand and 3–4 sparse navigation groups, then thin divider and tiny legal row

rules: use generic illustrative data and placeholders
avoid real personal or account information
keep graphics editable as HTML/CSS/SVG when implementing

pagePatterns.name: hero
pagePatterns.left: oversized multiline headline, brief support copy, compact email/action group, optional proof row
pagePatterns.background: off-white with subtle angular pale-aqua forms

pagePatterns.name: benefits-and-proof
pagePatterns.layout: centered section title followed by asymmetric soft-background cards
pagePatterns.cards: metric, transfer/speed visual, wide chart/insight tile

pagePatterns.name: process
pagePatterns.layout: full-width dark panel with three steps

pagePatterns.name: outcomes
pagePatterns.layout: centered headline and three minimalist metrics

pagePatterns.name: pricing
pagePatterns.layout: paired cards with one accent tier

pagePatterns.name: final-cta-and-footer
pagePatterns.layout: dark rounded CTA block, airy multi-column footer

responsiveBehavior.desktop: Use horizontal split hero, 3-up features, 2-up pricing, horizontal CTA, generous whitespace.
responsiveBehavior.tablet: Reduce large padding, keep two columns where readable, stack oversized mockups below hero if crowded.
responsiveBehavior.mobile: Single-column layout; headline then action then mockup; stack cards and steps; full-width inputs and primary buttons; 20px page gutters.
responsiveBehavior.overflow: No horizontal scrolling except intentionally constrained comparison tables.
accessibility: Do not communicate state with color alone

effects: gentle opacity/translate reveals only if motion preferences allow

implementation.recommended: Create CSS design tokens and reusable React components; use CSS Grid/Flexbox and SVG for decorative shapes and sample data charts.
implementation.tokenStrategy: Centralize all colors, spacing, typography, radii, shadows, and breakpoints; do not hardcode divergent values across components.
implementation.contentRule: Replace all reference-specific brand identity, company names, logo marks, business claims, monetary values, chart labels, and user data with new original content or neutral placeholders.
qualityChecklist: Strong visual contrast between white and navy sections
Mobile layout is deliberate, not merely squeezed
Components use tokens rather than arbitrary values

cursorInstruction: Treat this JSON as the visual source of truth. Build an original responsive marketing website inspired by the abstract styling, not the screenshot content. Before writing components, create design tokens. Prefer Helvetica/system sans, mist backgrounds, teal accents, navy feature blocks, minimalist iconography, airy editorial layout, coherent card patterns, and clear focus states. Do not copy screenshots, logos, personal details, text, or chart values.
